metadata.title: Linux Game
metadata.description: Linux Game - Test your knowledge about Linux and learn more about the operating system.

welcome.title: Welcome to Linux Game!
welcome.subtitle: Learn Linux interactively and fun
welcome.description: Linux Game is an educational platform where Linux beginners can use a simulated terminal to complete challenges and learn about the Linux world in a practical and engaging way.

1.title: Level One - What is the error line?
1.placeholder: Enter the line number and press enter...

one: Hello, adventurer! Welcome to the first challenge of Linux Game.
In this challenge, you will learn to redirect the output of one command to another command using the pipe operator (|).
Additionally, you will learn to filter results using text patterns with the grep command.
two: In some cases, we have output from a file or command with many lines, and we need to filter only the lines that interest us.
For this, we can use the grep command, which allows filtering lines according to a text pattern that you specify.
Using the pipe operator (|), we can redirect the output of one command to another command, and thus filter the results. Example:
three: Now, let's go to the challenge!
Imagine that you are auditing a server of a company's website and need to edit a message that was incorrectly inserted into the website and is causing legal problems
How would you find the correct line to edit?
The word that was incorrectly entered is a variation of 'public'. Your mission is to find the line where it appears.

success.message: Congratulations! you completed the first challenge!
success.description: You completed the challenge and learned a little more about the Linux terminal and the grep command, by the way, see a little more about it.
